title: Cute emojis
text: Cute emojis. These are such cute emoji magnets. They have a nice weight to each piece. Each one is about the size of a quarter. The colors are nice and not too strong of a yellow. The printing on each face is nice and clear to see. They come in a nice plastic case, good for storing and gift giving.
